_note: Criticality is a research-side overlay. The platform registry's FieldDef carries no `critical` flag, so it is declared here. A field is critical when a single wrong character changes the legal effect of the draft: identifiers, extents, and money. Names and addresses matter but tolerate transcription variance; identifiers do not.
_scoring: Critical fields are scored with exact match under both the platform normalizer and a strict normalizer. Fuzzy matching is never applied to them.
